name: Burrowing
summary: The animal can burrow.
description: The animal can burrow.

upgrade.text: The animal can burrow through stone, creating a tunnel of their size in each square of stone they move through.

source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Climbing
summary: The animal can automatically climb at full speed while moving.
description: The animal can automatically climb at full speed while moving.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Flight
summary: The animal can fly, and their stability decreases by 2 (to a minimum of 0).
description: The animal can fly, and their {@combat stability} decreases by 2 (to a minimum of 0).
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Leaping
summary: On their turn, the animal can high jump or long jump up to half their speed. This jump can allow the animal to move more squares than their speed.
description: On their turn, the animal can high jump or long jump up to half their speed. This jump can allow the animal to move more squares than their speed.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Slinking
summary: The animal can use a move action to shift up to 3 squares, even while prone.
description: The animal can use a {@action move-action|move action} to {@movement shift} up to 3 squares, even while {@condition prone}.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Swiftness
summary: The animal has a +2 bonus to speed, and they ignore difficult terrain.
description: The animal has a +2 bonus to speed, and they ignore {@combat difficult-terrain|difficult terrain}.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Swimming
summary: The animal can automatically swim at full speed while moving.
description: The animal can automatically swim at full speed while moving.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Camouflage
summary: The animal can attempt to hide even while observed. While no enemy has line of effect to the animal, they can automatically hide at the end of their turn.
description: The animal can attempt to hide even while observed. While no enemy has line of effect to the animal, they can automatically hide at the end of their turn.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Fearsome
summary: As a maneuver, the animal makes an imposing display.
description: As a {@action maneuver}, the animal makes an imposing display. Each enemy within 2 squares of the animal who has I < 1 must {@movement shift} 3 squares in a straight line away from the animal.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Pack
summary: While adjacent to an ally, the animal can't be flanked or be made frightened.
description: While adjacent to an ally, the animal can't be {@combat flanking|flanked} or be made {@condition frightened}.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Plated
summary: The animal has a +2 bonus to stability, and melee strikes against them take a bane.
description: The animal has a +2 bonus to {@combat stability}, and melee strikes against them take a {@combat bane}.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Spiny
summary: Whenever an adjacent enemy grabs the animal or uses a melee ability against them, that enemy takes 3 damage.
description: Whenever an adjacent enemy grabs the animal or uses a melee ability against them, that enemy takes 3 damage.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Stench
summary: At the start of the animal's turn, each enemy adjacent to the animal who has M < 1 must shift 1 square away from the animal.
description: At the start of the animal's turn, each enemy adjacent to the animal who has M < 1 must {@movement shift} 1 square away from the animal.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Thick Hide
summary: The animal starts any combat encounter with 10 temporary Stamina.
description: The animal starts any combat encounter with 10 {@resource temporary-stamina|temporary Stamina}.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Unrelenting
summary: Once per combat, when the animal is reduced to 0 Stamina, they can choose to either remain alive with 1 Stamina or immediately move up to their speed and make a free strike before…
description: Once per combat, when the animal is reduced to 0 Stamina, they can choose to either remain alive with 1 Stamina or immediately move up to their speed and make a {@action free-strike|free strike} before dying.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Wiggly
summary: The animal ignores opportunity attacks and gains an edge on the Escape Grab maneuver.
description: The animal ignores opportunity attacks and gains an {@combat edge} on the Escape Grab {@action maneuver}.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Withdraw
summary: Whenever the animal takes damage, they can use a triggered action to halve that damage and all other damage they take until the start of their next turn.
description: Whenever the animal takes damage, they can use a {@action triggered-action|triggered action} to halve that damage and all other damage they take until the start of their next turn.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Charger
summary: The animal's signature ability has the Charge keyword, and they gain an edge on that ability if it is used as part of the Charge main action.
description: The animal's signature ability has the Charge keyword, and they gain an {@combat edge} on that ability if it is used as part of the Charge {@action main-action|main action}.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Frenzy
summary: The animal gains an edge on strikes against creatures who are bleeding or winded.
description: The animal gains an {@combat edge} on strikes against creatures who are {@condition bleeding} or {@combat winded}.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Grappler
summary: If the target of the animal's signature ability has A < 1, they are grabbed by the animal.
description: If the target of the animal's signature ability has A < 1, they are {@condition grabbed} by the animal.

upgrade.text: An enemy grabbed by the animal takes a {@combat bane} on the Escape Grab maneuver.

source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Hunter
summary: The animal ignores concealment.
description: The animal ignores {@combat concealment}.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Multilimb
summary: The animal can target one additional creature or object whenever they make a free strike, use the Grab maneuver, or use the Knockback maneuver.
description: The animal can target one additional creature or object whenever they make a {@action free-strike|free strike}, use the Grab {@action maneuver}, or use the Knockback maneuver.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Pouncer
summary: As a maneuver, the animal jumps up to 3 squares.
description: As a {@action maneuver}, the animal jumps up to 3 squares. If they land on an enemy their size or smaller, that enemy is knocked {@condition prone} and the animal can make a {@action free-strike|free strike} against them.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Power
summary: Whenever the animal force moves a target, they have a +2 bonus to the forced movement distance.
description: Whenever the animal force moves a target, they have a +2 bonus to the {@combat forced-movement|forced movement} distance.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Projectile
summary: The animal's signature ability gains the Ranged keyword and adds Ranged 10 to its distance.
description: The animal's signature ability gains the Ranged keyword and adds Ranged 10 to its distance.

properties.optional: The animal's signature ability can deal acid or cold damage.

source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Reach
summary: The animal's signature ability gains a +2 bonus to distance.
description: The animal's signature ability gains a +2 bonus to distance.

properties.optional: The animal's signature ability can deal fire or sonic damage.

source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Venom
summary: The animal's signature ability deals an extra 2 poison damage, and if the target has M < 1, they are weakened (save ends).
description: The animal's signature ability deals an extra 2 poison damage, and if the target has M < 1, they are {@condition weakened} ({@duration save-ends|save ends}).
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Web
summary: The animal gains the Web ability: an Area, Weapon maneuver with a distance of 3 cube within 1, targeting each creature in the area.
description: The animal gains the Web ability: an Area, Weapon {@action maneuver} with a distance of 3 cube within 1, targeting each creature in the area. Power Roll + highest characteristic — 11 or lower: A < 0 {@condition restrained} ({@duration save-ends|save ends}); 12-16: A < 1 restrained (save ends); 17+: A < 2 restrained (save ends). Effect: the area is {@combat difficult-terrain|difficult terrain} for enemies until the end of the encounter.

granted_ability.name: Web
granted_ability.effect: The area is {@combat difficult-terrain|difficult terrain} for enemies until the end of the encounter.

properties.granted_ability_display: Web — keywords: Area, Weapon; action type: Maneuver; distance: 3 cube within 1; target: Each creature in the area; power roll: highest characteristic; tier1: A < 0 restrained (save ends); tier2: A < 1 restrained (save ends); tier3: A < 2 restrained (save ends); effect: The area is difficult terrain for enemies until the end of the encounter.

source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Death Fumes
summary: Whenever the animal takes damage, each creature adjacent to the animal who has M < 1 takes damage equal to half the creature's current Stamina.
description: Whenever the animal takes damage, each creature adjacent to the animal who has M < 1 takes damage equal to half the creature's current Stamina.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Elemental
summary: The animal has an affinity for one of the following damage types: acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison.
description: The animal has an affinity for one of the following damage types: acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison. The animal has {@resource damage-immunity|damage immunity} 3 to the chosen damage type, and their strikes deal the chosen damage type instead of their original damage type.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Gelatinous
summary: The animal can move through spaces as if they were size 1T.
description: The animal can move through spaces as if they were size 1T. Whenever the animal takes damage, they can use a {@action triggered-action|triggered action} to separate into two animals. Each new animal has the same statistics as the original but has half the original's current Stamina.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Hypnosis
summary: As a maneuver, the animal targets one enemy within 5 squares with their gaze, movements, or vocalizations.
description: As a {@action maneuver}, the animal targets one enemy within 5 squares with their gaze, movements, or vocalizations. If the enemy has R < 1, they are {@condition dazed} ({@duration save-ends|save ends}).
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Imposer
summary: The animal's size increases by 1 (to a minimum of size 2), and they gain a +2 bonus to stability. Additionally, the animal gains a +3 damage bonus to strikes.
description: The animal's size increases by 1 (to a minimum of size 2), and they gain a +2 bonus to {@combat stability}. Additionally, the animal gains a +3 damage bonus to strikes.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Pass Through
summary: The animal can move through solid matter, and strikes made against them take a bane.
description: The animal can move through solid matter, and strikes made against them take a {@combat bane}. If the animal ends their turn inside solid matter, they are shunted out into the space from which they entered it.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium

name: Translation
summary: The animal can teleport.
description: The animal can teleport.
source: Draw Steel Monsters Book, ch. 2 (Monsters — Animals) (mcdm.monsters.v1), via Steel Compendium
